perspective

logical

container

phase

explanation

Critic

ex: British weather is perhaps at its most variable in the spring.

static

(adjective). Lacking in movement, action, or change

ex: Oil prices have remained static for the last few months.

procedure

(noun). an established or official way of doing something.

ex: The company has new procedures for dealing with complaints.

negotiation

(noun). formal discussion between people who are trying to reach an agreement

ex: The exact details of the agreement are still under negotiation.

mechanical

(adjective). Operated by a machine or machinery.

ex: The company produces mechanical parts for airplane engines.

casual

(adjective). seeming not to be worried

ex: His clothes were artfully arranged to look stylishly casual.

contextually

(adverb). in a way that relates to the context or circumstances surrounding an event, statement, or idea

ex: Advertisers are charged for contextually relevant links and advertisements.

complex

(adjective). Consisting of many different and connected parts

ex: The company has a complex organizational structure.

discourse

(noun). written or spoken communication or debate

ex: there's a discourse on critical theory

subordinate

(verb). subordinate sth to sth: to treat somebody/something as less important than somebody/something else

ex: Her personal life has been subordinated to her career.

methodology

(noun). a system of methods used in a particular area of study or activity.

ex: The methodology and findings of the research team have been criticized.
